verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe Agentforce agents built into Sales Cloud that autonomously handle repetitive tasks across the deal cycle, with examples like qualifying inbound leads and updating opportunities, under admin-controlled access policies. Agent Builder supports natural-language setup. All of this is vendor marketing, and the pack does not show how a user actually hands a task to the in-product assistant. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-app delegation interface (e.g., a conversational assistant panel), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
